verdict.rationale: Built-in physics is a fair axis for a 3D library compared against game engines, so the story applies. The evidence pack covers renderers, TSL, loaders, controls and tooling, but nothing documents rigid bodies, collision detection or raycasting as part of three.js. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box
